title: Trace a feed decision through freshness, safety, and delivery
description: Switch scenarios to see how the feed keeps its online deadline while final policy, prepared media, and declared fallbacks protect the viewer contract.

nodes.label: Viewer app
nodes.detail: Sends session and device context, receives an ordered eligible batch, then starts playback from a signed CDN reference.

nodes.label: Edge candidate cache
nodes.detail: Stores short-lived eligible candidate batches keyed by the context that affects policy and freshness. It reduces repeated origin decisions.

nodes.label: Candidate retrieval
nodes.detail: Combines follows, interest, exploration, and trend sources after filtering each source for current eligibility and availability.

nodes.label: Ranker and features
nodes.detail: Scores a small candidate set with session and content features. It can time out without allowing policy checks to disappear.

nodes.label: Final policy gate
nodes.detail: Rechecks safety, region, age, rights, availability, diversity, and repetition before the feed response contains a video.

nodes.label: Video CDN
nodes.detail: Delivers a signed, device-appropriate rendition from a healthy edge or replica. It never serves the unprocessed original as a feed fallback.

nodes.label: Exposure event stream
nodes.detail: Captures exposure, watch, skip, completion, report, and playback outcomes without delaying the viewer response.

scenarios.label: Warm cache, eligible batch
scenarios.summary: A context-correct candidate batch is fresh enough for this viewer. The edge returns it, the final policy decision remains valid, and playback begins from the CDN.
scenarios.result: The cache removes origin feed work for this request, but its TTL and key must still prevent policy or session staleness from becoming an exposure bug.

scenarios.label: Cache miss, fresh rank
scenarios.summary: The edge needs a new decision. Retrieval and ranking run under the 200 ms budget, then the final policy gate removes any candidate that is no longer eligible or available.
scenarios.result: This path is freshest but consumes origin capacity. It is the path sized by the cache-miss traffic in the capacity lab.

scenarios.label: Ranker deadline exceeded
scenarios.summary: The heavy ranker misses its deadline. The service uses a bounded-age eligible batch instead of extending the swipe request, then applies final constraints before release.
scenarios.result: Personalization may be less current, but playback stays fast and no cached candidate bypasses safety, rights, availability, or session repetition checks.

scenarios.label: Moderation uncertainty
scenarios.summary: A selected video is awaiting human review or has uncertain policy evidence. The policy gate removes it even though retrieval, ranking, and delivery are healthy.
scenarios.result: The video does not enter the response. The feed can choose another eligible candidate, but it must not use the original upload or a stale score to override uncertainty.

scenarios.label: CDN region unavailable
scenarios.summary: The selected rendition cannot be reached from one delivery region. The delivery layer routes to a prepared healthy replica or a lower bitrate, while the feed avoids promising a dead playback URL.
scenarios.result: Availability becomes part of eligibility. A fast feed response is still a failure if it points to media that cannot start.
